Subject: Recap: Discovery + POC next steps (Lakeshore Health)

Hi Samantha / Tom -

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed POC plan so we can align on success criteria and owners:

High-level goals (what success looks like)
- Integrate Redwood Inference for production-like traffic to validate stability and latency: 95th pct latency < 300ms for typical queries
- Throughput: support 200 concurrent clinician sessions during peak window
- Data handling: patient PHI redaction on ingest + customer-managed KMS for keys (no persisted PII in Redwood logs)
- Functional: end-to-end integration with Lakeshore EHR excerpts and triage assistant prompts with acceptable fidelity

Proposed POC / evaluation plan (4 weeks)
- Week 0 (setup): network connectivity (VPC peering or secure VPN), service accounts, KMS handshake
- Week 1 (integration): ingest pipeline + sample prompts, basic inference calls, redaction verification
- Week 2 (validation): functional testcases, success criteria runbook, quality checks vs baseline
- Week 3 (load & ops): traffic ramp, latency/throughput measurement, fallback tests

Key asks / ownership needed from Lakeshore to proceed
- Infra owner (network, VPN/VPC, firewall rules) - name + contact
- App/Integration owner (EHR connector, dev resource) - name + contact
- Security/compliance owner for SOC2/KMS questions - name + contact
- Procurement contact for SOW/PO timelines - email

Attachments: Lakeshore_POC_plan_v1.pdf (POC checklist) and RACI_template.xlsx (editable) - also shared Drive link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cLakeshorePOC
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/AD12345-67890

If you can confirm the owners above and a tentative kickoff week (we proposed week of Dec 7), I'll loop in our solutions engineer and security lead and send an initial SOW draft.

Thanks,
